convertibility_reason: Uses external custom signal library (SignalCandelsHighOpen.mqh) for trading logic; cannot auto-convert without reading and porting the custom CSignalCHO class implementation

other_exits: Signal threshold close at 10 - CExpertSignal evaluates weighted signal and closes when threshold met

custom_logic_notes: Entry/exit logic is entirely encapsulated in CSignalCHO class from SignalCandelsHighOpen.mqh - cannot determine candle pattern conditions without reading that file. The CExpert framework uses weighted signal voting: filter0.Weight(1.0) with threshold open=10 and threshold close=10. Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated once per bar, not every tick. SL/TP of 50 points likely need digit adjustment (multiply by 10) for 5-digit brokers since no adjustment logic is visible.
python_conversion_notes: Must read SignalCandelsHighOpen.mqh to extract the actual candle pattern logic (CSignalCHO::LongCondition / CSignalCHO::ShortCondition). The standard CExpert framework boilerplate (init, signal voting, trailing, money) is well-known and can be mapped to a Python class structure. Parabolic SAR is available in ta-lib or pandas-ta. The fixed-risk money management (CMoneyFixedRisk) calculates lot size from SL distance and risk percent - needs manual porting. SL/TP values are in points (50) not pips - ensure point-to-pip conversion in Python.
